findings.title: Missing 'test' Script in package.json
findings.fix: Configured package.json with standard vitest run, test:watch, test:coverage, and build scripts.

findings.title: Unauthenticated & Replayable M-Pesa Callbacks
findings.fix: Implemented constant-time token comparison (timingSafeEqual / constant_time_compare), idempotency state machine, receipt collision protection, and amount matching.

findings.title: Kenyan Phone Number Formatting & Carrier Routing
findings.fix: Implemented comprehensive phone normalization covering 07xx, 01xx, +254, 254, national formatting, and Safaricom/Airtel/Telkom carrier detection.

findings.title: Currency Floating Point Inaccuracy & Leakage in Payout Splits
findings.fix: Implemented integer-cent KES currency arithmetic, 16% Kenya VAT calculator, coupon allocation, and zero-leakage vendor commission splitting.

findings.title: Inventory Stock Reservation Race Conditions
findings.fix: Implemented atomic inventory locking, timeout auto-expiry, payment failure rollback, and commit mechanics.
